# Benny Conn

> Software engineer at Ambrook, event producer, and jazz trombonist. Based in New York City.

Benny Conn is a software engineer and founder specializing in backend systems, AI-powered platforms, and full-stack product development. He works at Ambrook and is also building Jetside. He co-founded Curation Events and is a jazz trombonist and bandleader. His portfolio balances software, events and community programming, and music.

## About

- **Location**: New York City, NY
- **Current workplace**: Ambrook (ambrook.com)
- **Previous Role**: Backend Software Engineer II at Gallery (gallery.so)
- **Specialties**: Go, PostgreSQL, React, AWS, GCP, Docker, AI/ML, GraphQL, Redis
- **GitHub**: github.com/benny-conn
- **LinkedIn**: linkedin.com/in/benny-conn

## Projects

### Jetside (jetside.app)
An aircraft maintenance coordination platform Benny is building for business aviation teams.


### Gallery (gallery.so)
Social platform for sharing and discovering art. Built and maintained backend infrastructure handling millions of media assets, real-time notifications, and third-party data sync using Go, GraphQL, GCP.

### Gig App (gig.app)
Full-stack platform for gigging musicians — built the entire stack from React Native mobile app to Go backend, including Stripe payment splits, Redis caching, and AI-powered marketing automation.

### Minecraft Plugins
Developed multiple Minecraft plugins used by thousands of multiplayer servers globally, including Civilizations (land claiming and politics system) and Bundle (a plugin package manager). Built in Java and Kotlin.

### Curation Events (curation.events)
Co-founder and Creative Director of an independent event studio. Produced a Spotify × Aetna event for 400 guests with a $25k budget, 20 on-site staff, and 10 vendors. Filled a 120-person Williamsburg bar for a ticketed Gig App launch through organic outreach. Started a monthly jazz night at Ambrook with 140 attendees at the first night. Developed concepts and production plans for a series of $250k Chobani events, with approval to source vendors and finalize budgets. Event stories and proposals at bennyconn.com/work/curation-events.

## Music

Benny plays jazz trombone and leads the Benny Conn Big Band, rooted in bebop and swing. The homepage offers recordings, and bennyconn.com/music includes the full recording collection and live performances.

## Tour assistants

Benny sets up personal AI assistants for touring teams, starting with a one-tour pilot: incoming advance correspondence, reviewed Master Tour updates, and unresolved items. Setup is a one-time fee for the tour manager's team, takes about a week, and is quoted after an intro call; ongoing support is a separate monthly quote. Details and a quote form at bennyconn.com/tour-assistants.
